title: Bands are completely scrambled or wrong at a large scale
symptom: The KS/EXX/GW band figures show scrambled or broadly wrong bands; the artifact is not a local bump.
evidence_required: KS, EXX and GW tables for the same k grid

candidate_experiments.action: run layer localization and branch to r2 or r4
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: identifies which operator layer introduces the artifact before any parameter change
candidate_experiments.guard: do not change parameters before the layer is identified

stop_condition: The failing layer is identified (EXX -> r2, GW -> r4).
